currentParagraphText: “We will be sure to keep you in thought as we move forward,” Viridia spoke in a dignified voice as she said goodbye to her guest with a polite bow. The other party returned her bow before leaving, with Viridia simply unable to suppress a massive grin the moment they were gone.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: A god had just sought her out and spoken to her not like an equal but someone of superior position. To make it better, this wasn’t even the first time it had happened. Over a dozen gods had visited her over the last year or so, all of them on their best behavior in front of her, a mere mortal.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Rather than worry about some long-off future, it was better to focus on the now and enjoy whatever time he had with them. He knew that soon life would be busy once more, and he would have to stop being Jake Thayne, the son, and return to being Jake Thayne, the hunter and Chosen of the Malefic Viper.
